title: Token-bounded AI repository navigation
summary: Build one deterministic generated-context catalog, machine-readable index, bounded task-slice CLI, ranked feature cards, richer summaries, and a single low-token AI startup workflow.
reason: The current AI navigation instructions can require roughly 9,967 fixed-startup tokens and conflict with a second sequence that reaches roughly 47,749 word-estimated tokens. The 2,396-row Markdown index is too large for startup use, 81.34% of summaries have weak purpose markers, and feature selection mixes production authority with tests and change evidence.
behavior_before: Agents are directed through multiple large startup documents and a 2,396-row Markdown index. There is no bounded task query, JSONL catalog, generated feature-card set, or scoped instruction surface. Active-production priority is 89.37% medium and the feature-map candidate corpus is 48.84% non-production/evidence noise.
behavior_after: Agents read the global safety contract, request a deterministic budget-capped task slice, and open only the returned summaries, boundaries, source, and tests. All navigation renderers derive from one hash-backed record catalog and generated outputs have strict drift checks.
manual_validation: Baseline 2026-07-20: 2,396 index/summary records; 894 unparsed, 739 no-module-docstring, and 316 no-SYNOPSIS purpose markers.
Baseline 2026-07-20: feature candidates are 48.84% non-production/evidence noise; generated-context group is 83.75% change packets.
Baseline 2026-07-20: fixed startup 9,967 estimated tokens; conflicting combined guidance 47,749 word-estimated or 77,528 mixed-estimator tokens.
Baseline 2026-07-20: strict active production has 3.44% unknown owner (already below target) and 89.37% medium priority (needs at least 118 deterministic reclassifications).

rollback_plan: Revert only packet-listed source, test, instruction, and generator changes; remove the new JSONL/cards/scoped files; then run the prior summary, project-index, and feature-map generators. Restore any overlapping generated output from the byte-for-byte external snapshot only after verifying the current file hash still matches this task's post-generation hash; otherwise perform a three-way merge. Preserve all pre-existing dirty paths and their packet ownership.
notes:
ECC blueprint with dependency, verification, rollback, and adversarial-review gates. Search-first audit chose a stdlib shared-record layer and reuse of existing summary discovery, hash freshness, local import resolution, path validation, and run-python-tool conventions. External package/network search was intentionally skipped because the required behavior is repository-specific and the objective forbids dependency or network expansion. The adversarial review was resolved by making source plus canonical inventories authoritative, treating generated views as siblings, adding a schema/parser fingerprint, requiring fixed-point checks, freezing feature taxonomy before consumers, defining an exact byte-based budget algorithm, and requiring hash-guarded three-way preservation of overlapping dirty generated outputs.
Implement and validate the token-bounded generated-context catalog, retrieval CLI, enriched summaries, feature cards, and unified AI instructions.
Test-first acceptance fixtures added for parser enrichment, deterministic JSONL, path validation, exclusions, fixed feature taxonomy, ranking, layer diversity, budget enforcement, low-confidence fallback, related tests, and feature-card drift.
A just-in-time second checkpoint replaced optimistic reliance on the initial snapshot after 27 generated summaries changed concurrently. Manifest: C:/Users/lmmye/.codex/visualizations/2026/07/20/019f7db4-a3d7-72b3-ab32-cee61c9b8b9d/ai-context-backup/pre-generation-20260720/manifest.json.
